visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a person's hands holding a large, white cloud-like cotton candy on a green-and-white striped stick over a pot of boiling clear broth. On the table, there are multiple plates of raw red beef, a large white bowl of assorted vegetables including leafy greens and mushrooms, and a smaller bowl of braised pork over rice. The lighting is bright and warm, typical of a modern restaurant interior with textured grey-brown walls. (2) The scene shifts to a blue self-service cotton candy machine; a hand with a ring on the index finger presses a large green button. The machine's internal metal spinner rotates rapidly, creating white sugar threads inside a clear plastic dome. This is followed by a sequence of clips showing white rice being scooped into a bowl, a scoop of popcorn being gathered, coffee pouring into a white cup, and three scoops of pink and white ice cream in a small black dish. (3) A claw machine filled with snack bags is shown; a hand inserts a coin, and the mechanical claw descends to grab a red and yellow snack package labeled 'Oriko'. The person holds the snack bag up to the camera, showing a cartoon orange character on the front. (4) The focus returns to the food; a small glass bottle of milk is poured into a bubbling pot of red spicy soup, followed by a spoon lifting a piece of tofu and another spoon tasting clear broth. Two large vegetable platters are presented, followed by close-ups of raw marbled beef and pork being dipped into the soup and shown cooked. A large wooden platter of seafood including shrimp, squid, and oysters is displayed, with a dedicated bowl of fresh grey oysters. (5) The camera pans across the restaurant interior, showing a beverage station with Coca-Cola logos, wooden tables, and customers sitting in the background. Finally, the scene shows the exterior of the restaurant, a two-story building with a wooden entrance and a white sign with black text reading '拾鮮鍋物' under a clear, bright sky.
